node.title: Re^2: How can I keep the first occurrence from duplicated strings?
node.author: afoken
node.doctext:
You could just reverse the order of the lines in the file...

use strict; use warnings; my @lines = reverse();

This will read the entire file into RAM. No problem for 100 kBytes, big trouble for big files (larger than free RAM). The solutions from [id://11154125|choroba], [id://11154126|Grandfather], [id://11154130|eyepopslikeamosquito], and the second solution from [id://11154128|tybalt89] do not suffer from that problem, because they all read only one line at a time.

Alexander

--
Today I will gladly share my knowledge and experience, for there are no sweeter words than "I told you so". ;-)
